name: Stream Cipher Assessment
description: Assessment of stream cipher implementations including ChaCha20, RC4 (legacy), and Salsa20. Covers nonce/IV management, keystream reuse detection, cipher selection review, and identification of implementation weaknesses specific to stream cipher constructions.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to stream cipher concepts or assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands stream cipher fundamentals and how they differ from block ciphers
evidence: Can explain how a stream cipher generates a keystream and XORs it with plaintext
Understands why RC4 is deprecated and its known biases
Can describe the role of nonces in stream cipher security

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Identifies stream cipher usage and common misconfigurations under supervision
evidence: Detects RC4 usage in TLS configurations and protocol implementations
Identifies nonce reuse risks in ChaCha20/Salsa20 deployments under guidance
Documents stream cipher findings following lab templates

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently evaluates stream cipher implementations for correctness and security
evidence: Assesses nonce generation and management in ChaCha20-Poly1305 deployments
Identifies keystream reuse vulnerabilities and demonstrates impact
Evaluates stream cipher selection against current best-practice guidance (RFC 8439, RFC 7465 prohibiting RC4 in TLS, BSI TR-02102)
Produces compliant findings with clear remediation recommendations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex stream cipher assessment scenarios; identifies subtle implementation flaws
evidence: Analyses custom protocol implementations using stream ciphers for nonce management flaws
Demonstrates keystream recovery attacks against nonce-reuse in lab environments
Reviews junior staff assessments of stream cipher implementations
Develops tooling to detect stream cipher misuse patterns in code

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines stream cipher assessment methodology; recognised authority on stream cipher security
evidence: Authored or maintains lab methodology for stream cipher assessment
Published research on stream cipher vulnerabilities or novel attack techniques
Provides expert consultation on stream cipher selection for protocol design
Trains teams on stream cipher internals and assessment approaches

assessment_methods.description: Given a protocol implementation using ChaCha20, identify nonce management issues and demonstrate the impact of keystream reuse
Review stream cipher assessment findings from a recent engagement for accuracy and completeness
